instruction.text: Find the word ______ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: sceptical. in the sentence.

atoms.b: The substitute teacher was ((sceptical)) of whether the lesson plan was interesting enough for her students.
At first, I was ((sceptical)) of my teacher, but as I got to know her, I learnt that she’s very kind.

atoms.b: What is your ((perspective)) on the price of peanut butter?

instruction.text: Find the word ______ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: dependence. in the sentence.

atoms.b: I have a financial ((dependence)) on my parents.

instruction.sound: Find the word: consequence. in the sentence.

atoms.b: Well, well, well: if it isn’t the ((consequence)) of my own actions.
Giving your phone to the teacher is a ((consequence)) of texting in class.

instruction.text: Find the word ______ in the sentence.
instruction.sound: Find the word: vaccinate. in the sentence.

atoms.b: My uncle does not want to ((vaccinate)) his children.

instruction.sound: Find the word: sacrifice. in the sentence.

atoms.b: I don’t want to ((sacrifice)) my independence.
